messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "take exactly as your doctor tells you to"
set: ["take exactly as your doctor tells you to", "take exactly as your doctor prescribes", "take exactly as prescribed", "take only if doctor tells you to", "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "only take potassium-rich foods if doctor tells you to", "take with a meal unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "take exactly as prescribed by healthcare provider", "pregnancy unless doctor tells you to", "take as prescribed by your doctor", "use exactly as directed", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "use exactly as directed on the label or as prescribed by your doctor", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
